images.scene: A single weathered wooden shipping crate sitting LOW in the frame on the clean floor of a vintage warehouse, seen from a few steps back, its heavy lid slightly PRIED OPEN at one corner with an iron crowbar leaning against its side, warm bright light GLOWING strongly from inside the crate through the gap, soft rays cutting upward through the dim air, nothing else around it, minimal and clean. The crate occupies only the BOTTOM HALF of the frame, its top edge at the vertical middle, bleeding off the bottom edge. The ENTIRE upper half of the image is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A weary middle-aged business owner in rolled-up shirt sleeves standing SMALL between towering stacks of wooden crates and boxes rising on both sides of him, end of a long day, hands on hips, head slightly bowed, 1950s Brazilian small factory. The stacks and the man fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A man's hand firmly pressing a single CLEAN BLANK sheet of white paper down on top of a wooden desk buried in messy piles of old papers, receipts and worn ledgers; his other hand holds a wooden pencil ready to draw, vintage 1950s office. The blank sheet is the bright center of the scene. All papers completely blank with no readable writing.
